steps.name: Connect Standard test account unavailable; the platform account is used
throwaway webhook endpoint created for its signing secret
Dial created a real Checkout Session through its own confirm route
test card 4242 paid on Stripe's hosted Checkout page; Stripe returned to Dial's return URL
the return URL alone created no booking
the real signed checkout.session.completed confirmed exactly one booking (a mis-signed copy was 401, a duplicate added nothing)
Dial's sweep expired the second real session through POST /v1/checkout/sessions/:id/expire and released the slot

notProven: Stripe-to-Dial webhook delivery: the local Worker is not reachable from Stripe, so the real event was fetched with GET /v1/events and delivered by this harness
A real Connect OAuth grant: the fleet holds no Connect client ID; the connected account was recorded through a test-only fixture
transport: Dial's Worker request bytes relayed unchanged by a local forwarder because the sandbox Worker runtime has no direct egress
